title: Truth online code
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 2: Hadith, akhlaq and Important Lessons
source: Written for islamic-studies/y8 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: truth online code)
intro: Lesson 16: Avoiding lies: jokes, exaggeration and online. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

passage.title: Bukhari and Muslim
paras: The signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when he is trusted he betrays.

cards: Making up a story to make friends laugh
Saying 'I've told you a million times'
Keeping a secret you promised to keep
Correcting a post you shared by mistake
blocks.title: Sort into: A lie / Not a lie
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: A lie, Not a lie.
blocks.answer: A lie: Making up a story to make friends laugh; Sharing a rumour without checking; Fake reviews online. Not a lie: Saying 'I've told you a million times'; Keeping a secret you promised to keep; Correcting a post you shared by mistake

panels.title: Online truthfulness
points: Do not pretend to be someone else

head: Rule
Reason from the Qur'an or Sunnah (from our lessons)

keywords.def: hypocrisy: showing one thing, hiding another
making something sound bigger than it is
trust: what is left in our care
false information shared, even by mistake

questions.q: Explain why breaking a promise is linked to hypocrisy.
questions.a: A promise is a trust; the hadith lists breaking promises as a sign of the hypocrite (Bukhari and Muslim).

questions.q: Write a 'Truth online' code of five rules for a Muslim youth group chat on the pupil PDF, each with a reason from the Qur'an or Sunnah.
questions.a: Five rules (verify, no fake accounts, no mocking, keep promises, correct mistakes) with 49:6, 49:11, 17:34, the hypocrite hadith

questions.q: Extend: why is a 'joke lie' still harmful?
questions.a: It is still untrue, can hurt people and makes lying easy.

questions.q: Stretch: how can a Muslim be honest and kind at the same time?
questions.a: Choose gentle words and timing; stay silent rather than lie.

questions.q: Which is a sign of the hypocrite?
questions.a: A) Breaking promises. Lying, breaking promises and betraying trust (Bukhari and Muslim).

questions.q: Which ayah tells us to verify news?
Think again: is sharing an unchecked post a lie?
questions.a: It can spread falsehood; verify first (49:6).
